001package dayplanner;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005import javax.swing.JTextField;
006
007/**
008 * Represents the Swing GUI search activities panel. Extends {@link GUIWindow} to share
009 * common configuration, layout, and component handling with other GUI
010 * panels such as {@link GUIAddWindow}.
011 */
012public class GUISearchWindow extends GUIWindow {
013    /**
014     * Create a new Swing GUI search panel.
015     * 
016     * @param activities Instantiated ActivityList.
017     */
018    public GUISearchWindow(ActivityList activities) {
019        super(activities);
020    }
021
022    /**
023     * {@inheritDoc}
024     * 
025     * @return Title string for the search window.
026     */
027    @Override
028    public String getWindowTitle() {
029        return "DayPlanner - Search";
030    }
031
032    /**
033     * {@inheritDoc}
034     * 
035     * @return Header HTML text for the search window form.
036     */
037    @Override
038    public String getHeaderText() {
039        return "<html><b>Searching activities:</b></html>";
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * {@inheritDoc}
044     * 
045     * @return Subheader HTML text explaining search parameters are optional.
046     */
047    @Override
048    public String getSubHeaderText() {
049        return "<html>Fields are optional; leaving a text field blank means the search will ignore that parameter.</html>";
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * {@inheritDoc}
054     * 
055     * @return Action button label "Search".
056     */
057    @Override
058    public String getActionButtonLabel() {
059        return "Search";
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * {@inheritDoc}
064     * 
065     * @return Action command string "SEARCH".
066     */
067    @Override
068    public String getActionButtonCommand() {
069        return "SEARCH";
070    }
071
072    /**
073     * {@inheritDoc}
074     * 
075     * @return Array of type options with "any" first, followed by "home", "school", and "other".
076     */
077    @Override
078    protected String[] getTypeOptions() {
079        return new String[]{"any", "home", "school", "other"};
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * {@inheritDoc}
084     * 
085     * @return Label for the south message area "Search Results:".
086     */
087    @Override
088    public String getMessageBoxLabel() {
089        return "Search Results:";
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * {@inheritDoc}
094     * 
095     * @return Array of field labels for the search form. Comment and Location
096     *         fields are omitted as the search function ignores them.
097     */
098    @Override
099    public String[] getFieldLabels() {
100        return new String[] {
101            "Type:",
102            "<html>Title <i>(keywords)</i>:</html>",
103            "<html>Starting time <code>(YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM)</code>:</html>",
104            "<html>Ending time <code>(YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM)</code>:</html>"
105        };
106    }
107
108    /**
109     * {@inheritDoc}
110     * 
111     * @return true if search was performed, false if validation failed.
112     */
113    @Override
114    public boolean executeAction() {
115        return trySearch(activities, centerFields);
116    }
117
118    /**
119     * Input-validate and try to search for activities matching the criteria.
120     * 
121     * @param activities   Instantiated ActivityList.
122     * @param centerFields List of JTextField instances in the center panel.
123     * @return true if search was performed, false if validation failed.
124     */
125    public boolean trySearch(ActivityList activities, ArrayList<JTextField> centerFields) {
126        clearMessages();
127
128        if (activities == null || centerFields == null || centerFields.size() < 3) {
129            addMessage("Internal error: missing form fields.");
130            return false;
131        }
132
133        // 1. Activity type
134        String typeStr = (typeComboBox != null) ? (String) typeComboBox.getSelectedItem() : "";
135        ActivityType type = "any".equals(typeStr) ? null : ActivityType.parse(typeStr);
136
137        // 2. Title keywords (optional)
138        String titleStr = centerFields.get(0).getText().trim();
139        String[] keywords = null;
140        if (!titleStr.isEmpty())
141            keywords = titleStr.split("\\s+");
142
143        // 3. Start time (optional)
144        String sTimeStr = centerFields.get(1).getText().trim();
145        Time sTime = null;
146        if (!sTimeStr.isEmpty()) {
147            sTime = parseAndValidateTime(sTimeStr, "Starting time", false);
148            if (sTime == null)
149                return false;
150        }
151
152        // 4. End time (optional)
153        String eTimeStr = centerFields.get(2).getText().trim();
154        Time eTime = null;
155        if (!eTimeStr.isEmpty()) {
156            eTime = parseAndValidateTime(eTimeStr, "Ending time", false);
157            if (eTime == null)
158                return false;
159        }
160
161        // 5. Start vs End order (if both are provided)
162        if (sTime != null && eTime != null && sTime.compareTo(eTime) >= 0) {
163            addMessage("Ending time (" + eTime + ") has to be after starting time (" + sTime + ").");
164            return false;
165        }
166
167        // 6. Execute search
168        List<Integer> titleMatches = activities.findTitleMatches(keywords);
169        int count = 0;
170        for (int index : titleMatches) {
171            Activity act = activities.get(index);
172            if (DayPlannerUtils.matchesCriteria(act, type, sTime, eTime)) {
173                count++;
174                appendMessage(count + ". " + act.toString());
175            }
176        }
177
178        if (count == 0)
179            appendMessage("No activities matched your search request.");
180        else
181            appendMessage("Found " + count + " matching " + (count == 1 ? "activity." : "activities."));
182
183        return true;
184    }
185}
